newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Chemical bids for 32.3 pct Chemical Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Chemical bids for 32.3 pct Chemical Portugal.

text.p: Chemical-SGPS and insurer Mundial Confianca, both owned by Portuguese businessman Antonio Champalimaud, said they had launched a public offer to buy at 1,650 escudos per share for the outstanding 32.3 percent stake in Banco Chemical Portugal not already held by Chemical-SGPS.

"The public offer to buy is for 5,249,450 nominal ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1,000 escudos each, representing 32.3 percent of the company," said a statement published in the bulletin of Lisbon stock exchange.
In February Champalimaud's Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor bought Chemical-SGPS, which held a 67.7 percent stake in Banco Chemical Portugal.
